scope_note: Administrative workflow assistance for small construction contractors. The scope excludes engineering, estimating authority, safety sign-off, code or permit approval, trade instructions and unsupervised site decisions.
summary: Test supervised intake, schedule coordination, change-order records and invoice-package follow-up against the contractor's incumbent workflow. Preserve professional review of scope, quantities, safety, quality, contract rights, permits and payment approval.

automation_research.finding: Federal labor recordkeeping and EPA renovation guidance support careful records, retention and trained-person boundaries; vendor pages show workflow capabilities but do not establish installed base, achieved automation or savings. Construction work, safety and technical approvals remain accountable human work.
automation_research.forecast_note: No automation percentage, adoption prevalence or savings forecast is supported by these sources; any value result requires a measured contractor baseline.

processes.process: Bid invitation, estimate-input and subcontractor-document intake
processes.automation_boundary: Collect approved plans, scope notes, due dates and vendor documents; check presence, versions and obvious conflicts for human review. Do not price work, interpret engineering drawings, select means or methods, certify quantities or submit a bid without authorized review.
processes.baseline_required: Matched bid packets, intake/review minutes, missing-version and duplicate rates, rework, late-submission incidents, access errors and actual administrative cost.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per complete, correctly versioned bid packet including review, exception and rework effort; late or wrong-submission rate
processes.falsifier: Reject if scope/version errors, unauthorized disclosure, missed deadline or review/rework increase, or automation is treated as estimating or engineering authority.
processes.human_authority: Authorized estimator, project manager and qualified design/trade professionals control scope interpretation, quantities, price, exclusions, bid approval and submission.

processes.process: Administrative schedule, meeting-action and document coordination
processes.automation_boundary: Transcribe approved actions, track due dates, link current documents and draft reminders from recorded status. Do not create a construction sequence, direct field labor, resolve conflicts or make weather, safety, quality or critical-path decisions.
processes.baseline_required: Matched meetings and tasks, coordinator minutes, stale/duplicate action items, acknowledgement latency, missed escalations, document-version errors and correction effort.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per accurately acknowledged action/document update including review and exception handling; stale-item and wrong-version rates
processes.falsifier: Reject if a stale action or wrong document reaches the field, safety/quality escalation is delayed, or review/rework offsets the time reduction.
processes.human_authority: Project manager and designated superintendent/qualified professionals approve sequence, field instructions, safety, quality and schedule-impact decisions.

processes.process: Change-order request, approval and contract-record coordination
processes.automation_boundary: Assemble dated requests, correspondence, photos and approved cost/schedule fields; flag missing approvals and draft a status packet. Do not determine entitlement, price, causation, code impact or authorize changed work.
processes.baseline_required: Matched change events, assembly/review minutes, missing-evidence and duplicate rates, approval latency, disputed/reworked packets, privacy incidents and actual contract-administration cost.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per accepted, traceable change-order packet including review/rework; missing-approval, dispute and unauthorized-work rates
processes.falsifier: Reject if an unapproved change is treated as authorized, contract or safety rights are misrepresented, disputes/rework rise, or private documents are misrouted.
processes.human_authority: Contract owner, authorized project manager, estimator and qualified design/trade professionals decide entitlement, cost, schedule, technical implications and approval.

processes.process: Invoice, pay-application and receivables follow-up administration
processes.automation_boundary: Check required fields and attachments, reconcile status to approved records and draft follow-ups to verified recipients. Do not calculate or certify earned value, retainage, tax, lien rights or payment approval, and do not send unreviewed demands.
processes.baseline_required: Matched invoice packages, preparation/review minutes, missing-attachment and duplicate rates, correction/rejection latency, payment follow-up effort, access incidents and actual cash impact.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per accurate approved invoice package/follow-up including review and rework; rejection, duplicate, wrong-recipient and aging rates
processes.falsifier: Reject if a false amount or deadline is sent, a required record is missing, privacy/contract rights are breached, review/rework rises or cash outcome is claimed without measurement.
processes.human_authority: Authorized finance and project personnel, contract owner and accounting/tax professionals approve quantities, billing, retainage, notices, payment decisions and records.

pilot.design: Within one authorized contractor, compare matched redacted or synthetic bid, schedule, change-order and invoice packets under the incumbent and supervised candidate workflows; pre-register document-version, privacy, contract, labor and professional-authority gates.
record: wrong-version, missed-escalation, unauthorized-disclosure and unapproved-action cases
reject_if: Human time including review/rework is not lower than matched baseline.
Any unapproved technical, safety, contract, billing or payment decision or unauthorized disclosure occurs.
A stale or incomplete record causes a missed deadline, wrong instruction or unapproved work.
Measured first-year net cash is not positive for a cash-savings offer; released capacity is not cash.

limitations: This is not engineering, safety, code, permitting, tax, labor, contract or construction advice, product admission or an industry-wide forecast.
Current software adoption prevalence and subscription prices were not verified; named offerings are not assumed installed.
No generic repository is claimed to replace the contractor's contract, accounting, document-control, safety or professional-authority systems.
Rights, security, retention, restoration, integrations, accessibility, field connectivity and state/local requirements remain product-owner gates.
